heading: Batch jobs → live change streams
line: Kafka since 2023, from real-time streaming at Grid Elevated to change data capture for reconciliation jobs at Goldman Sachs.

sources.text: Engineered Kafka-based change data capture for the team's long-running reconciliation jobs, replacing scheduled batch extracts with change streams so downstream teams see data as it lands.
Deployed Apache Kafka for real-time streaming, so downstream services consumed data as it was produced instead of waiting on scheduled batch runs.

heading: 90+ TB moved off on-prem storage
line: Archival to S3, and a lead role in moving sensitive, write-heavy data stores from the data lake to the lakehouse.

sources.text: Migrated 90+ TB of long-term records from on-premises storage to AWS S3 archival, reclaiming the capacity previously provisioned to hold them.
Led the migration of the team's sensitive, write-heavy data stores from the data lake to the lakehouse, coordinating the cutover with the teams that build dashboards and reports on them.

heading: ~40% less admin work for faculty
line: From a scheduling application for faculty, plus a student field tracker with ~60% faster retrieval.

sources.text: Built a Java/Spring Boot, Hibernate, React, and PostgreSQL scheduling application for faculty, reducing administrative workload by ~40%.
Shipped the Student Field Tracker in Angular, TypeScript, C#, ASP.NET, and SQL Server, with ~60% faster retrieval.

heading: Payment flows, domestic and overseas
line: Built in Java Spring Boot microservices, tested with JUnit and Mockito, and released through Jenkins and Kubernetes.

sources.text: Built domestic and overseas client payment flows in Java Spring Boot microservices and Spring MVC.
Tested transaction workflows with JUnit and Mockito before release, catching defects in review, not production.
Automated the release path with Jenkins and Kubernetes, cutting deployment errors across releases.
